# Tui Torque Motors (Car Master Automotive)
> Family-run car servicing, WOF, wheel alignment, diagnostics and repairs in Wiri, Auckland. Est. 2020.

## Key facts
- Address: Unit 2, 69 Wiri Station Road, Wiri, Auckland 2104
- Phone: 09 869 7579 (landline) / 022 095 0555 (mobile/text)
- Hours: Mon–Fri 9am–5pm, Sat–Sun walk-ins for standard servicing, after-hours/WOF/repairs by appointment
- Google rating: 4.8/5 from 52 reviews (verified Google Business Profile)
- Services: Full car servicing, WOF inspections, wheel alignment + nitrogen, diagnostic scanning, brakes & safety, fleet maintenance, ECU tuning & emissions diagnostics, suspension lift/lowering kits, custom exhaust
- Pricing: Diagnostic scan $60, Basic service $160, Standard service $230, Wheel alignment $80 (all +GST)
